body: When I launch psalm on my big project, i see this error, but if i launch it two times: first time on the first half of my project and the second time on the second half of my project - it works.
Would you be able to run with `vendor/bin/psalm --debug-by-line` to figure out which file/line Psalm crashes on? And then, if possible, paste the offending code?

The result of launching vendor/bin/psalm --debug-by-line :
`/Users/k.pilipenko/taxiserv/classes/order.php:3755
/Users/k.pilipenko/taxiserv/classes/order.php:3756
/Users/k.pilipenko/taxiserv/classes/order.php:3757
/Users/k.pilipenko/taxiserv/classes/order.php:3758`

`Fatal error: Uncaught InvalidArgumentException: Could not get class storage for self in /Users/k.pilipenko/psalm/vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Internal/Provider/ClassLikeStorageProvider.php:43
Stack trace:`
`#0 /Users/k.pilipenko/psalm/vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Internal/Codebase/Methods.php(85): Psalm\Internal\Provider\ClassLikeStorageProvider->get('self')`
`#1 /Users/k.pilipenko/psalm/vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Internal/Analyzer/Statements/Expression/Call/MethodCallAnalyzer.php(556): Psalm\Internal\Codebase\Methods->methodExists('self::getvalue')`
`#2 /Users/k.pilipenko/psalm/vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Internal/Analyzer/Statements/Expression/Call/MethodCallAnalyzer.php(199): Psalm\Internal\Analyzer\Statements\Expression\Call\MethodCallAnalyzer::analyzeAtomicCall(Object(Psalm\Internal\Analyzer\StatementsAnalyzer), Object(PhpParser\Node\Expr\MethodCall), Object(Psalm\Codebase), Object(Psalm\Context), Object(Psalm\Type\Atomic\TNamedObject), NULL, NULL, false, false, true, false, Array, Array, Array, Array)`
`#3 /Users/k.pilip in /Users/k.pilipenko/psalm/vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Internal/Provider/ClassLikeStorageProvider.php on line 43`

order.php on 3757, 3758, 3759 lines is
`if (self::isCanHoldOnRequest($request)) {
        $update['hold_status'] = HoldStatus::needHold()->getValue();
}`

As I sayed, my project is very big and I think that the problem is here. As we can see analyze failed on order.php But if I launch analyzer on all directories, connected with orders, it works. Also if I ignore order.php file, the analyzer failed on another file (Service.php) on line `return new LevelPromotion(`
What does `HoldStatus::needHold` return?

And is the call done inside `HoldStatus`, or a child class?

It'd be incredibly useful if you could isolate this to something on https://getpsalm.org

What about `@method static getSomething()`? Generally, `static` is a valid type name (at least under PSR-5), so I think it's ambiguous what this is supposed to mean if you accept `static` as a modifier.

See phpDocumentor/phpDocumentor2#822 - it seems to be referenced by Phan as well. The approach phpdoc appear to have taken is to treat `static foo()` as a method returning `static`, and for static void to require it spelled explicitly as `static void`

This rule (allowing the `@method` to be called statically) only kicks in with
`@method static <someReturnType> methodName()`

Is it? I'm getting `InvalidDocblock` for `@method static foo()`: https://getpsalm.org/r/cf5737c771
Not sure if it worked previously though.
Ah ok, well that should probably still work
I downloaded your last commit and now all works fine. Thank you!
You're welcome!
